name: Bingles' Screwdriver
summary: Across Loch Modan's northern islands, Bingles' Screwdriver lies among the gear lost in a crash. Troggs carried it off with the tools of pilot Bingles Blastenheimer.

sections.title: A Pilot's Vital Kit
sections.body: When Bingles Blastenheimer crashed into Loch Modan, he lost the tools needed to repair his gyrocopter. Troggs on nearby islands carried off his tool buckets, and the screwdriver was packed in one of them. Bingles needs it for fine adjustments as he repairs the craft and handles its armaments.

sections.title: Preparations for the Retaking
sections.body: Bingles works to free Gnomeregan from troggs and leper gnomes. He means to join his flying skill with volatile Blastencapper munitions in an aerial assault. The screwdriver, wrench, and hammer will help him rebuild his gyrocopter and keep the airborne counteroffensive alive.

faq.answer: After Bingles crashed, troggs scattered his Toolbuckets across the islands in northern Loch Modan. The screwdriver is inside one of them.

faq.q: Why is the screwdriver so important to Bingles?
faq.answer: Bingles needs the screwdriver and his other tools to rebuild his gyrocopter and prepare explosives for the campaign to retake Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Who stole the screwdriver in the first place?
faq.answer: After Bingles crash landed, troggs living on the islands in Loch Modan took his tool buckets and Blastencapper explosives.

faq.q: What other tools did Bingles lose in the crash?
faq.answer: Along with the screwdriver, Bingles lost his wrench, hammer, and volatile supply of Blastenheimer Blastencapper explosives.

angles.text: As a gnome, each tool you recover brings Bingles closer to rebuilding his craft and fighting the troggs and leper gnomes who drove your kin from Gnomeregan.
As an engineer, you know a precisely made screwdriver is vital for intricate gyrocopter rotors and delicate trigger assemblies.
